flowchart TD
  TRIG["On-demand owner action\nUS or India symbol - Settings gated"] --> BUNDLE["Market-local data bundle\nquote - fundamentals - scores - holding context"]
  BUNDLE --> A1["Market / Technical"]
  BUNDLE --> A2["Sentiment / News"]
  BUNDLE --> A3["Fundamentals"]
  BUNDLE --> A4["Macro context"]
  A1 --> BULL["Bull advocate"]
  A2 --> BULL
  A3 --> BULL
  A4 --> BULL
  A1 --> BEAR["Bear advocate"]
  A2 --> BEAR
  A3 --> BEAR
  A4 --> BEAR
  BULL --> EVAL["Research evaluator"]
  BEAR --> EVAL
  EVAL --> RISK["Risk desk\nRisky / Neutral / Safe"]

TRIG.label: On-demand owner action
TRIG.description: Runs only from an owner action or a valid cron-secret caller; no schedule currently invokes it. Both POST and cached GET are owner-gated before service-role reads. Canonical US class tickers and India .NS/.BO symbols are accepted; malformed symbols are rejected before provider calls.
TRIG.addReason: The multi-call debate is useful as optional research, not as an automatic money-path dependency.
TRIG.changeReason: Closed the authenticated-non-owner service-data leak and replaced the US-only ticker grammar with the canonical US/India validator.

BUNDLE.label: Market-local data bundle
BUNDLE.description: US uses Massive with price-cache fallback for quotes and Alpha Vantage OVERVIEW for fundamentals. India uses Yahoo INR quotes and Yahoo India fundamentals. Prior signals and paper holdings are scoped by both symbol and market. India never inherits the US FRED macro regime. Provider text is context for the LLM and cannot become an executable score.
BUNDLE.addReason: Ground the debate in current app evidence instead of model memory.
BUNDLE.changeReason: Made the previously partial India wiring real: valid symbols now reach India-capable quote and fundamental sources.

MODEL.label: One configurable model
MODEL.description: All analyst, advocate, evaluator, risk, and PM calls use the one model configured for agent_name=deep-dive. The route resolves that model to its provider and checks the matching provider key; it does not hardcode DeepSeek.
MODEL.addReason: One source of model truth avoids per-node labels drifting after a Settings change.
MODEL.changeReason: Verified the configured-provider key fix remains intact.

A1.label: Market / Technical analyst
A1.description: Assesses price action and the recorded technical context. It may explain evidence but cannot alter the deterministic technical score.
A1.addReason: Structured technical lens before the debate.

A2.label: Sentiment / News analyst
A2.description: Explains the recorded sentiment score and rationale and must state when evidence is thin.

A3.label: Fundamentals analyst
A3.description: Reads the market-local fundamental block: Alpha Vantage for US and Yahoo India for NSE/BSE names.
A3.changeReason: India no longer attempts a US-only Alpha Vantage path.

A4.label: Macro analyst
A4.description: US receives the recorded US macro regime. India is explicitly told that the US FRED regime is unavailable rather than receiving cross-market context as if it were domestic evidence.
A4.addReason: Structured macro lens with explicit market limits.
A4.changeReason: Verified market isolation and documented the India unavailable state.

BULL.label: Bull advocate
BULL.description: Builds the strongest evidence-based BUY case from the analyst reports.

BEAR.label: Bear advocate
BEAR.description: Builds the strongest evidence-based avoid or sell case and identifies concrete risks.

EVAL.label: Research evaluator
EVAL.description: Weighs the bull and bear cases and states a non-executable lean plus the decisive evidence.

RISK.label: Risk desk
RISK.description: Produces aggressive, conservative, and balanced perspectives plus the principal risk to monitor.

PM.label: Portfolio manager
PM.description: Produces BUY, HOLD, SELL, or PASS with conviction. A SELL for an unheld name is deterministically rewritten to PASS, but every verdict remains advisory.
PM.addReason: Produce one readable synthesis while retaining a code-enforced long-only boundary.

STORE.label: deep_analyses
STORE.description: Stores the advisory report, model, token counts, and cost. The route writes no agent_signals, positions, proposals, orders, or fills, and no money-path consumer reads this table.
STORE.addReason: Keep optional research auditable without granting execution authority.
STORE.changeReason: Both write and read surfaces are now owner-only.

history.label: Deep-Dive Debate
history.reason: Added an on-demand adversarial research report with no execution authority.

history.label: One configurable model
history.reason: Removed fictional per-role model assignments and bound provider-key validation to the configured model.

history.label: Owner-only and genuinely market-aware
history.reason: An adversarial review found that any authenticated user could reach service-role reads and that the claimed India support was blocked by a 1-5-letter US regex. Both GET and POST now enforce owner access; canonical India symbols use Yahoo INR quotes and fundamentals, while US behavior is unchanged.
